title: Free Health Checkup Camp – Ranga Reddy District
location: Government PHC, Shamshabad, Ranga Reddy District
summary: Free general health checkups, eye screening, and medicine distribution for 340 villagers.
description: In partnership with two visiting general physicians and an ophthalmologist, Prayas Seva hosted a free health camp at the Shamshabad Primary Health Centre. 340 villagers were screened for common ailments, blood pressure, and diabetes; 95 received free spectacles after eye screening. Basic medicines were dispensed on-site, and cases requiring further treatment were referred to Gandhi Hospital with follow-up support from our health team.
